_doc: Class definitions (DESIGN 2.12, 6.3). python tools/build_classes.py turns this into loot tables, enchantments and
function/class/gen/**. Hand-written ability logic lives in function/class/<class>/ (hooks listed per class).
tier: basic = selectable, re-applied on respawn, team upgrade level 1-3 picks the loadout;
shop  = one-time, lost on death. Its items get curse of vanishing (never drop) and armour gets binding (locked).
items: slot = armor.head|armor.chest|armor.legs|armor.feet|weapon.offhand (equipped, old item returned to you)
or 'supply' (shop classes: a plain kit consumable given once on apply, no class tags: blocks, food, spare tools, starting arrows).
or 'inventory' (given; must stay with the owner: dropped copies are deleted and it comes back).
gear = hotbar convention override for plain bases (weapon|bow|pickaxe|bucket|tool|none -> custom_data nx_gear, nonios:gear/category).
components = raw 26.3 item components (JSON form). name/lore are text components; custom_data and the
class tags are added by the generator. Vanilla look via item_model until we have textures.
lost_msg: shop classes only, shown on death. vision: post effects (resource pack) in stacking order; added on apply, removed on death / class change, re-added on rejoin.
enchantments: raw enchantment definitions written to data/nonios/enchantment/class/<key>.json (dynamic registry: restart).
kill_tier: victim tier for the kill bonus (nx.tier -> economy kill_bonus/tier, V2 tier 1/2/3 = +20/+90/+190). Shop classes: fixed;
basic classes: team level - 1 (V2: respawn kit II = tier 1, kit III = tier 2). Back to 0 when the class goes (death, reset).
shop: present = sold by the team shopkeeper for price coins from the purse (sprite = button icon, items atlas).
confirm = function run instead of the purchase (it applies the class itself; free classes only).
hooks: on_apply, on_strip (hand-written class/<id>/<hook>), tick (every tick), second (once a second), as/at each player of the class.

_v2_roster._doc: V2 shop kits (WhiteShop 73-80, 89, 666): price and kill tier. All but Warrior are implemented (classes below); basic Warrior here is the placeholder, not the V2 60-coin kit. V2 sold the Monster kit for 300 (Monster Transformation) and the head alone for 1800 (Monster Skull); the remaster sells the full class for 1800.

archer.blurb: Chainmail locked on, a bow that marks what it hits, a quiver that slowly refills. Stone tools, sandstone and carrots.

lore.text: Quiver: an arrow back every 3s (up to 16)

miner.blurb: Sees in the dark, digs faster, Block Pulverizer for bursts (it makes you glow). Leather locked on, torches, cobblestone and steak.

lore.text: Minecrafter dream: you wish it existed in survival

tank.blurb: Iron locked on, shield locked in the off-hand, 2 extra hearts, hard to push. Ironskin flask: resistance and regeneration. Iron tools, stone, bread.

ninja.blurb: No armour but the sandals: fast, light on its feet, runs on water. Genjutsu Booster: a few seconds invisible and very fast.

berserker.blurb: A battle axe that hits like a truck and makes you fast, unshakeable and regenerating. While it is out your armour counts for nothing.

lore.text: Your uncontrollable fury makes you strip
In hand: armour 0, fast, no knockback, regenerating

champion.blurb: Grows with every player it kills while undefeated: a heart and some damage per kill, up to 5. From 3 kills everyone sees it, and whoever brings it down takes the bounty. Iron locked on, golden crown.

lore.text: 3+ kills: you glow, your killer takes the bounty
Die once and it is over

reaper.lost_msg: Death came for the Reaper. Ironic.
reaper.blurb: Glass cannon that flies. Scythe heals you and slows on hit, kills give souls, 4 s of invisibility and 8 s untouchable, right-click releases the souls as a burst. 5 hearts, armour locked.

lore.text: Nothing to protect. Nothing to lose.
Nothing to protect. Nothing to lose.
Nothing to protect. Nothing to lose.
Only the souls of the living can grant eternal life... or Death
Hit: steal 2 hearts, slow (once per swing)

monster.blurb: 10 extra hearts, bigger, faster, claws that tear. Always starving: every kill is devoured for a burst of strength, speed and healing. No armour, locked skin.

lore.text: Kill: devour (heal, Strength II, Speed II)

balrog.lost_msg: The shadow is gone. For now.
balrog.blurb: A Demon of Shadow and Fire from the Ancient times. Huge, 150 hearts, armour 20, fireproof, cannot jump but climbs walls. Its smoking trail curses enemies with wither.

lore.text: A Demon of Shadow and Fire from the Ancient times
The vital essence of ancestral creations
The vital essence of ancestral creations
The vital essence of ancestral creations
From the blazing abyss of Hell, this Mythical artifact
was created to bring desperation upon mortals

cracy_frog.blurb: #Useful. Huge jumps, a broom that (sort of) flies, a tongue that drags people into the sky and lets them drop. Leather armour locked on, and the world never stops melting.

lore.text: Hold right-click: fly where you look
3s of flight, refills on the ground
Right-click: tongue (12 blocks), yanks up whoever it catches
Shift + right-click: RIBBIT (wind bursts all around)
Hit: something random happens to someone

warrior.blurb: Basic class (placeholder for the framework): the V2 'Automatic Kits'. Team upgrade I chainmail / II iron / III diamond. Re-applied on every respawn.
